failure_modes.cause: Vapour pressure of acetonitrile exceeds pump inlet pressure at T > 40°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurise feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above vapour pressure

failure_modes.cause: Particulate matter or crystallization in the flow path
failure_modes.mitigation: Install inline filter before BPR and ensure regular maintenance

failure_modes.cause: Fouling or misalignment of light source
failure_modes.mitigation: Regularly clean and align light source; monitor light intensity

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage stops all flow
validation_experiments: Run blank acetonitrile at Q=0.5 mL/min for 60 min; monitor pressure for drift > 5%
Test BPR valve with particulate-laden solvent to assess blockage risk
Measure light intensity at reactor outlet to ensure consistent photon delivery
